title: Offer farm debt mediation before enforcing a farm mortgage
what: Take enforcement action under a farm mortgage only while an exemption certificate is in force for the farm debt (granted after mediation, or if the farmer declines it).

sources.title: Farm Debt Mediation Act 1994 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A creditor must not take enforcement action in respect of a farm mortgage unless an exemption certificate granted to the creditor is in force in respect of the farm debt concerned
